title: Tiling 2xN Grid with Dominoes

monster.name: Domino Gargoyle
monster.title: Plaver of 2x1 Domino Blocks
monster.defeatQuote: Fibonacci recurrence tiled the 2xn grid completely!

description: You have a `2 x n` board and `2 x 1` domino tiles. Return the number of ways to tile the board completely modulo `10^9 + 7`.
solutionCode:
def tileGrid2xN(n: int) -> int:
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    if n <= 1: return 1
    a, b = 1, 1
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        a, b = b, (a + b) % MOD
    return b
hints: Ways to tile 2xn is Fibonacci sequence: f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2).

def tileGrid2xN(n: int) -> int:
